glosses: Any monarch ruling an empire, irrespective of gender, with \"empress\" contrasting to mean the consort of an emperor.

examples.text: Where is Sindbad? I have a summons for him direct from the galactic emperor herself. He is to be brought here immediately to give an explanation for his recent actions.
